annotations.text:
TWO DESIGNS, NOT ONE THAT SQUEEZES.

The phone is laid out for a phone. A profile header with your photo, name and role as one block. Nine years in a 3x3 grid, all of them on screen. Three facts as three rows, all readable without moving anything. And a bar pinned at the bottom carrying Email me, so nobody scrolls back up to find you.

Only the work cards still swipe. Each one carries a paragraph and an outcome, so six stacked would be a very long scroll, and the peeking edge tells you there are more. Say if you want those stacked too.

Expand either artboard to use it properly.

THE WORDS STAY IN ONE PLACE.

Two layouts would normally mean two copies of the text that drift apart. Main owns the data; tools/sync-phone-data.cjs lifts it into the phone file. Verified byte-identical.

Edit Main, run the script, re-seed.

STILL OPEN: your photo, and the real months for Express Scripts and Bank of America.
